reason: The patch changes docs/guides/templates/kc.adoc:53 to `bin/kc.[sh|bat] update-compatibility ${parameters} --features=rolling-updates`. That CLI value outranks KC_FEATURES and keycloak.conf, and PersistedConfigSource has ordinal 200, so it replaces any other features the user set. `features` is a build-time option, so with --optimized the check in Picocli.java:404-437 throws 'build time options have values that differ from what is persisted' unless the image was built with exactly that value.
